title: Isuzuma n'Ibitekerezo ku Masomo ya MediBook
instructions: Isuzuma ryimbitse ku byagezweho n'ubunararibonye bwo kwiga mu isomo ryo Kubaka Porogaramu zo ku Rwego rwo Heduru (Advanced Backend Development).
q1: 1. Ni iyihe ngingo muri iri somo yagusabye imbaraga nyinshi cyane, kandi kubera iki?
a1: Ingingo yansabye imbaraga nyinshi cyane kandi ikangora muri iri somo ni ijyanye n'ihererekanyabubiko (database transactions) hamwe n'ubudatana (atomicity). Mu ntangiriro, byari bigoye gusobanukirwa uburemere n'ingaruka zikomeye zibaho mu gihe ibyiciro byo kubika amakuru bidatunganiye rimwe—cyane cyane muri serivisi zikoresha amafaranga no kwandika gahunda zo kubonana na muganga, aho ikosa rito rishobora guteza igihombo, guha abantu babiri umwanya umwe, cyangwa kwangiza amakuru. Kumenya uko amategeko ya ACID akorana, uko bacunga imiyoboro y'ububiko muri Node.js idahagarara, no gukoresha uburyo bwo gufunga amakuru y'umurongo (row-level locking na SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) byansabye imbaraga nyinshi, ariko kubimenya byatumye nsobanukirwa neza akamaro k'ubudatana mu bwubatsi bwa sisitemu zizewe.
q2: 2. Sobanura igitekerezo kimwe wumvise neza nyuma y'imyitozo ngiro. Ni iki cyagufashije kucyumva neza?
a2: Igitekerezo numvise neza by'ukuri nyuma y'imyitozo ngiro ni ibijyanye no gukoresha ububiko bwihuse bwa Redis (caching) no gucunga imirongo y'abategereje. Mu masomo yo mu ishuri, kubika amakuru byasaga nk'ibisanzwe mu magambo, ariko mu myitozo ngiro ubwo nageragezaga gusaba amakuru kenshi nkabona itandukaniro ry'igihe bifata gukura amakuru kuri disiki ya MySQL n'igihe bifata kuyakura mu bubiko bwa 'RAM' hakoreshejwe Redis, byaranyuze cyane. Kubona uburyo umuvuduko wiyongereye bikagaragarira mu mibare byatumye ndushaho kubisobanukirwa. Byongeye kandi, gukoresha amategeko nka RPUSH, BRPOP, n'uburyo budatatana bwa LMOVE mu kwimura abategereje umwanya (waitlist) byanyeretse ko Redis atari ububiko busanzwe gusa, ahubwo ari umuyoboro ukomeye ukemura ibibazo by'umuvundo w'abakoresha benshi icyarimwe.
q3: 3. Uburyo bwawe bwo gutegura ububikoshingiro cyangwa za API bwahindutse gute kuva iki gihembwe cyatangira?
a3: Uburyo bwanjye bwo gutegura ububikoshingiro na za API bwarahindutse cyane buva ku gukora ibintu by'ako kanya bujya ku rwego rwa kinyamwuga kandi rwizewe. Mbere, nateguraga imbonerahamwe z'ububiko mu kajagari nkisunga imiterere yoroshye kwangirika ya JavaScript mu kugenzura amategeko y'ubucuruzi. Uyu munsi, ntegura ububikoshingiro nkurikije amategeko akaze yo gusukura amakuru (3NF), nkitwaza amategeko y'ububiko ubwabwo nka CHECK, kurinda gusiba amakuru bifitanye isano (ON DELETE RESTRICT), n'inkingi zibara ubwazo amakuru (generated columns) zifite urufunguzo rwihariye rwo guha undi muntu umwanya wasubijwe. Ku ruhande rwa za API, ubu nkurikiza amahame ya REST akoresha amazina mu bwinshi, inshinga za HTTP zikwiye, n'imibare y'imyitwarire ya HTTP ifite ibisobanuro nyabyo (201, 400, 404, 409, 422). Ikirushaho kuba ingenzi, nize gushyira ibarura rikomeye n'amategeko ya CTE imbere muri SQL aho kubikorera muri JavaScript, bigatuma porogaramu yihuta kandi yoroha gukurikiranwa.
q4: 4. Ni iki wanonosora ku buryo iri somo ryigishijwemo cyangwa ryasuzumwemo?
a4: Muri rusange, iri somo ryigishijwe mu buryo bwiza cyane bw'indashyikirwa, rifite n'isuzumabumenyi ngiro ry'ingenzi rihuye neza n'ibikenewe ku isoko ry'umurimo. Imyigishirize yari 100% itunganye, kandi ingingo zose zasobanuwe mu buryo bwumvikana neza. Ikintu kimwe gusa nanonosora ku batubanziriza mu bihe bizaza ni ukongera igihe gihabwa uyu mushinga ukamara igihe kirekire mu gihembwe cyose. Ibyo byatuma abanyeshuri babona umwanya uhagije wo gukurikiranwa umwe ku wundi n'umwarimu, gukora isuzuma ry'imyandikire ya kodi (code reviews) mu buryo bwimbitse, no kubona umwanya wo gucukumbura ibijyanye no gukwirakwiza no kwagura sisitemu nta gitutu cy'igihe gito.
q5: 5. Uteganya gute gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo wize muri iri somo mu gihe kizaza?
a5: Natangiye no gushyira mu bikorwa ubumenyi nakuye muri iri somo mu gihe cy'imenyerezamwuga ryanjye muri SOMA Foundation Rwanda. Aho dukorera, dufite porogaramu ikorera kuri murandasi yo mu nzu (offline web app) ikorera kuri 'mini PC' zifite ubushobozi buke mu mashuri. Mbere, gushaka amapaji ahoraho, ibitabo by'ikoranabuhanga n'ibindi bikoresho byafataga igihe kirekire kirenze igikenewe. Ariko nyuma yo gukoresha uburyo bwo kubika amakuru byihuse (caching), kunonosora ibibazo bya SQL, no gukoresha imiterere y'amakuru itaremereye nize muri iri somo, gusoma no kubona ibyo bitabo byarushijeho kwihuta cyane no koroha kuri ibyo byuma bito. Mu bihe biri imbere, ntegereje gukomeza gukoresha aya mahame mu mishinga yanjye yose—nkurikiza imyubakire iboneye ya za API, kurinda ubudahangarwa bw'amakuru mu bubiko, no gukoresha imirimo ikorera mu ibanga (background workers) itangiza imikorere ya sisitemu.
